exposure: Doppler ultrasound measurements of the two umbilical arteries
outcome: Agreement of Doppler ultrasound measurements of the two umbilical arteries
Discriminative ability of the two umbilical arteries for adverse perinatal outcome
finding: Doppler ultrasound measurements of the two umbilical arteries in SGA fetuses show good agreement and do not differ in their ability to predict adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Doppler ultrasound measurements of the two umbilical arteries did not differ in their ability to predict cesarean section for fetal distress in SGA fetuses.
